batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2021-2022, Set-Q — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Pathshala 'Academic & Admission' solved online-exam compilation PDF (pp.93-124 of the compilation). This is a typeset online-exam export, NOT a scan of the original printed paper: the correct option is the filled radio bullet, and each question is followed by a worked 'Explanation' box. Keys recorded here are the compilation's own marked options, preserved as-is; they are NOT official JU keys. No 'Blank' pseudo-option occurs in Set-Q. Printed anomalies preserved and noted per question (notably Q46's unrelated explanation, Q47's repeat of Q46's integral, and several marked keys that differ from their own printed explanations: Q42, Q52, Q61, Q80). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]
